note: Commercially he is close to ideal and clinically he is the hardest case in the batch. Successful and income are unambiguous — he founded and still runs a mindfulness business, and paid $6,000 in full without asking about the price until minute forty. He is not deconditioned or gym-averse: he trains across four modalities every week, owns a home gym, takes creatine and reads the literature. The two misses run the other way from most of this corpus. Health is the opposite of neglected — he has a personal trainer, a chiropractor, bodywork, a DRX decompression machine and a class habit, and is arguably over-attending to it without coordination. And this is not good-to-great; it is a rebuild toward a 2018 baseline he lost, from 160 lb at 10% body fat to 190 lb at 20%. The finding that matters is the one the pilot already logged and that this call confirms at higher severity: the stated ICP screens on success, income and starting point and contains no clinical criterion whatsoever. A man in a back brace with a ruptured L5-S1 disc, who cannot perform spinal flexion, axial load, deadlifts or kettlebell swings, passes every criterion in the list. Judged against the criteria as written he is edge and buys; judged against whether his body can perform the programme's core movement library, nobody judged at all.
